name: Spain
gaps: GOB Mallorca, the well known Balearic conservation group, blocks automated verification on its own domain (persistent 403), so GOB Menorca is listed for the Balearics instead.
No local group with its own site was found for Ceuta or Melilla.
Coverage for Castilla y Leon and Castilla La Mancha relies on single province level SEO groups (Salamanca, Ciudad Real, Albacete) rather than a regionwide body.
Federations calling themselves ornithological, such as FOCDE, turned out to be cage bird and canary breeding federations and were excluded as out of scope.

name: Portugal
gaps: No independent bird clubs with their own sites were found for mainland districts such as Porto, Algarve or Coimbra, or for Madeira, beyond SPEA's national programmes; a Madeira group using the ornithological name turned out to be a cage bird show organiser and was excluded.

Active public Facebook groups for Portuguese birders (Aves de Portugal, Aves de Portugal Continental 2.0, Aves Silvestres de Portugal) were found but Facebook blocks automated verification, so no unverified Facebook link is included here.

The eBird Portugal portal returns a bot check page to automated requests even though it is the platform SPEA itself recommends for logging sightings, so treat that link as needing a manual sanity check.

groups.blurb: Portugal's national bird society and BirdLife partner, running reserves, counts and volunteer programmes.

groups.name: PortugalAves eBird
groups.blurb: The eBird portal SPEA recommends for Portuguese birders to log their sightings.

groups.name: Forum Aves

groups.name: Asas do Mar

name: Gibraltar
gaps: Only one active organised birding body was found for Gibraltar. Migration counts at the Strait are also covered from the Spanish side by COCN in Tarifa, already listed under Spain.
